text:
maria: saw a spike of GPU resets on eu-west-2 today, 3 nodes in rack 7 reporting Xid 31 and PCIe link resets around 09:12 UTC
ashok: can you paste the dmesg snippet? looks like PCIe root port flapping in past incidents
maria: here, from node euw7-r03:```[  546.123456] nvidia 0000:03:00.0: GPU 0: Xid (PCIe Bus Error): 31, pid=2345, ctx=0x3, fault on pcie root port
[  546.123479] pcieport 0000:00:1c.0: AER: Corrected total=5
[  546.123501] pcieport 0000:00:1c.0: bridge to 0000:03:00.0 supports D3cold
```
ben: that exact log pattern matches some flaky riser/slot hardware we've replaced before, not thermal. any power-cycling done?
maria: yes did soft-reset and node recovered but containers restarted, happened twice within an hour
ashok: please put euw7-r03, euw7-r04, euw7-r05 into drain state and cordon. I'll move workloads to dedicated spare pool (reserve-dedicated-1)
ops-bot: [automated] node euw7-r03 marked DRAINING by ashok at 2024-11-03T09:20:15Z
lia: tagging vendor - we need RMAs for 3 cards. can someone grab serials and GPU fw versions? also note that these are on an older riser SKU per inventory
maria: serials pasted from `nvidia-smi -q | grep Serial`:
- PG1234567890
- PG1234567891
- PG1234567892
fw versions: 53.12.01, 53.12.01, 53.10.99
ben: fw mismatch on last one, but similar failures previously were hardware. I'll open a vendor ticket and request depot swap with riser checks
vendor-jira-bot: Created ticket RI-48291: Vendor confirmed initial triage, requested logs + `lspci -vvv` and `dmidecode`. ETA vendor response 24h. Link: https://vendor.example/RI-48291
lia: include photos of PCIe slot + riser, and label hostnames and chassis IDs in the ticket. vendor needs images for depot to accept returns
ashok: ops note: capacity drop ~6 GPUs for eu-west-2 while spares move. rescheduling long batch jobs to us-west pool to avoid SLA impact
maria: packaging note: these GPUs are under special export controls, vendor requires return manifests and EORI on paperwork. ops please don't send via standard overnight without customs docs
lia: I'll coordinate with procurement for courier that handles EORI. can we request depot swap (send replacement first, return used later)? vendor suggested RMA type: advance exchange for cases like this
ben: yes request advance exchange. add spare shipping to EU depot: DE-HAM-DEPOT. include `swap_type: advance-exchange` and `riser_check: required` in ticket comments
maria: adding logs and `dmesg | tail -n 50` and `journalctl -u kubelet --since "2h ago"` outputs to ticket now
vendor-jira-bot: Vendor updated RI-48291: Accepted advance-exchange, depot DE-HAM-DEPOT, provisional courier ETA 3 business days. Please attach packing list and customs form
ashok: ok plan: 1) keep nodes drained until replacements arrive, 2) move critical services to reserve-dedicated-1, 3) prep manifest and photos, 4) vendor to ship replacement GPUs to DE-HAM-DEPOT. I'll create a shortpostmortem template to capture impact and cost (courier + expedited RMA fee)
lia: will follow up on EORI paperwork and book courier after vendor confirms address. ping me if anything changes
maria: thanks all. quick check: can infra team flag these serials in inventory as 'quarantined' so we don't reprovision them into other clusters accidentally?
ben: done. quarantined list updated in inventory-db with note "PCIe reset cluster eu-west-2 rack7"
ashok: thumbs up. once replacements arrive we'll schedule slot-level riser inspection before insertion. :thumbsup:
